summary.zhHans: 《逃离方块：阿尔勒》的玩家角色。档案只讨论游戏对这位历史艺术家的超现实改编，不把游戏情节当作现实传记。
summary.en: The player character of Cube Escape: Arles. This archive treats the game as a surreal adaptation of the historical artist, not as a literal biography.

zhHans.text: 游戏将阿尔勒卧室、绘画和自画像式镜像组织成围绕文森特·梵高展开的逃脱空间。

en.text: The game organizes the Arles bedroom, paintings, and self-reflective imagery around Vincent van Gogh.

zhHans.text: 后段把镜中的自我转化为腐化灵魂，可以理解为游戏把角色的内在冲突视觉化；这是档案解释，而不是官方对梵高生平的判断。

en.text: The late-game transformation of the mirror image into a Corrupted Soul can be read as a visualization of inner conflict. This is an archive interpretation, not an official judgment about van Gogh's life.

reason.zhHans: 涉及《逃离方块：阿尔勒》的后段剧情。
reason.en: Contains later-story information from Cube Escape: Arles.

alt.zhHans: 文森特·梵高的原创档案式人物插画，不复刻具体作品
alt.en: Original archival portrait illustration of Vincent van Gogh without reproducing a specific artwork
